title: Planner: redesigned My Tasks experience on the web
summary: The briefing is supported by Microsoft's notice, the roadmap and the cited Planner documentation. The automatic rollout, December window, licensing and organisation-wide PowerShell control are accurately reported; no redesign-specific opt-out was found.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans a redesigned Planner My Tasks experience bringing tasks together to help users capture and prioritise work.
claims.quote: A redesigned My Tasks experience that brings your tasks into one place, making it easier to capture work, prioritize what matters, and stay focused.

claims.quote: Users with a qualifying Microsoft 365 license have access to a rich set of capabilities for individual and team work management. ... My Day, My Tasks, and more.

claims.where: Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Planner for admins lists task creation and editing, My Day and My Tasks among qualifying Microsoft 365 users' capabilities.
claims.quote: task creation and editing capabilities, various plan views - including Grid, Board, Schedule, and Charts - My Day, My Tasks, and more.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: No licence requirement specific to this My Tasks redesign is published at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner My Tasks redesign 561204 disable opt out admin setting licensing storage Teams; "Planner" "My Tasks" "redesign" licensing price storage Teams. Opened Planner for admins, manage-planner-app and Microsoft Planner service description; none specifies a redesign licence, price or meter.

claims.where: Why it matters; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The notice names no additional licence, charge or spending change for the redesign.
claims.quote: The updated experience provides clearer navigation, improved task organization, and streamlined task creation workflows, enabling users to create and manage tasks more efficiently without leaving their current context.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not yet describe this specific My Tasks redesign.
claims.quote: Searched: "Planner" "My Tasks" "redesign" licensing price storage Teams; "Planner" "My Tasks" "redesigned" disable opt out PowerShell Graph configuration. Opened Planner for admins and manage-planner-app; their My Tasks descriptions do not identify this redesign.

claims.where: Scope: Platforms; Open questions
claims.claim: Whether this specific redesign also reaches Planner in Teams is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner My Tasks redesign 561204 disable opt out admin setting licensing storage Teams; "Planner" "My Tasks" "redesign" licensing price storage Teams. Read roadmap, MC1488844, Planner for admins and manage-planner-app; no explicit Teams rollout for this redesign.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified whether the redesign changes which My Tasks sources appear.
claims.quote: Searched: "Planner" "My Tasks" "redesign" licensing price storage Teams. Read MC1488844, manage-planner-app, Planner for admins and Planner admin FAQ; existing source/storage descriptions do not specify the new workflow's destination or source changes.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls; rendered controls table
claims.claim: Set-PlannerConfiguration -IsPlannerAllowed $false is the documented organisation-wide Planner off command, not a redesign-only switch.
claims.quote: If you're a global admin and you want to turn off Microsoft Planner for your organization, you can use Windows PowerShell. ... Set-PlannerConfiguration -IsPlannerAllowed $false

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls; rendered controls table
claims.claim: The documented role for the organisation-wide Planner PowerShell control is global admin.
claims.quote: If you're a global admin and you want to turn off Microsoft Planner for your organization, you can use Windows PowerShell.

claims.where: controls[0].note; rendered controls table
claims.claim: Setting IsPlannerAllowed to $true turns Planner back on.
claims.quote:
To turn on Planner back:

Set-PlannerConfiguration -IsPlannerAllowed $true

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls; rendered controls table
claims.claim: The off-control documentation applies to basic plans in Planner in Teams and on the web.
claims.quote:
This article applies to:
- Basic plans in the Planner app in Teams and Web
- All plans in other Planner endpoints (including Planner mobile, and Planner connectors).

claims.where: controls[0].ui; rendered controls table
claims.claim: No admin UI equivalent is documented for the organisation-wide Planner service switch shown in this row.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner web turn off organization admin center IsPlannerAllowed UI setting. Opened disable-planner and Planner admin FAQ; read manage-planner-app. They give PowerShell for the service switch; the Teams app Block control is not an equivalent web-service switch.

claims.where: controls[1]; Governance controls; Open questions; rendered controls table
claims.claim: No UI or API switch is documented to defer or opt out of this My Tasks redesign separately from disabling Planner.
claims.quote: Searched: "Planner" "My Tasks" "redesigned" disable opt out PowerShell Graph configuration; Planner web turn off organization admin center IsPlannerAllowed UI setting. Read disable-planner, Planner admin FAQ, Planner for admins and manage-planner-app; no redesign-specific switch.

claims.where: Governance controls: final paragraph
claims.claim: For Planner in Teams, removing a user's Exchange Online licence hides My Tasks.
claims.quote: To hide My Tasks, remove the user's Exchange Online license. It's important to know that after you remove an Exchange Online license, the user no longer has access to their mailbox.

claims.where: Governance controls: final paragraph
claims.claim: The Teams article does not confirm that removing Exchange Online licensing hides the redesigned web experience.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner My Tasks redesign 561204 disable opt out admin setting licensing storage Teams; "Planner" "My Tasks" "redesigned" disable opt out PowerShell Graph configuration. Opened manage-planner-app; its Exchange licence guidance is for Teams, not this web redesign.
